exposure: mean diffusivity on diffusion tensor imaging (DTI)
FA of the splenium of the corpus callosum
FA of the middle cerebellar peduncle (MCP)
cohort: The study included 60 very-low-birth-weight (VLBW) infants born at 24-32 weeks of gestational age and 15 full-term controls.
finding: Delayed maturation of the middle cerebellar peduncle (MCP) fractional anisotropy (FA) at near-term age significantly predicted cognitive and motor impairment in VLBW infants at 18 months of corrected age.
